main_text.p: rūm loquuntur. Tertium non fœdus, sed pactum cumOmconecPactum cum Omgone Snelz-gero & Dammonensibus. Sneigero & Dammonensibus initum à civitate eodem anno, tantùm de cædibus aliquid determinans: in cujus formula Dammonenses nominatos invenio, de gemeine buren van dem Damme. In eodem verò hoc, ut & in tertio evidens indicium extat, paulò antè cum universis Fivelgoniis & HunesgoniisNota. in nova pacta& fœdus consensisse eandem civitatem: quotū exempla periisse dolemus. Anno sequente M. cccc. xvii, mense Junio, cùm glisceret rumor de consiliis Ultrajectini (cui sederat in animo, Groningam ad jusjurandum sibi dicendum adigere) & vicissim de Occone Broecmerio Kenonis filio aliquid suspicionis esset, cum Fivelingiis & Hunesgoniis convenitConventio inter civi-tatem & agri ordi-nes civitati, ne pars altera sine altera de cooptando domino consilia iniret: secus facienti, bis mille scuta-torum veterum poena esset. Et cùm biennio post civitas importunitate Episcopi superata in fidem se ejus vel invita contulisset, agrarii ordines quoque hi iidem, & cùm his Humerzii, Langowoldii, Fre-dowoldii,

page.notes: The first word "rūm" is a fragment carried over from the previous page and is kept as such. The marginal note "cPactum" begins with a stray letter or mark before "Pactum"; it is transcribed as printed. "de gemeine buren van dem Damme" is set in black letter and is marked with bl. The printed "xvii" in "M. cccc. xvii" is read as shown. The scan is slightly soft at the right edge, but the margin notes are legible.
